scoring_justification: T1 recompute infeasible because the verifier sandbox cannot re-run the entire SCF calculation from raw integrals; only final numeric results are submitted. T2 consistency also infeasible due to absence of raw intermediate artifacts. Hence we compare the agent's reported values to the paper's published results with generous tolerances to absorb implementation differences.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 2 of the source paper (σ-π system column for Z*=0.3625)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly copied from the paper's Table 2 values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own reported computed results; no fabrication.

outputs.description: JSON file with the computed σ-π system dipole moment (Debye), N-V₁ and N-V₂ excitation energies (eV) and oscillator strengths, and ionization potential (eV) for the peptide model with hydrogen 2pπ Z* = 0.3625.

output_contract.notes: The CI procedure is assumed to be a singles (singly‑excited) CI built from the π orbitals. Only the σ-π system at Z*=0.3625 is scored; the π-only system and other Z* values are omitted.
